_meta.description: The processed-evidence streams: the built-in logs-*-* composition (logsdb, ECS dynamic mappings, the operator's logs@custom extension point) plus the logs-dxdfir@custom component, which wires the per-type ingest pipelines. The failure store (rejected evidence rows) is kept a year instead of the cluster default's 30 days — a rejected row is evidence waiting for a mapping fix and a re-ingest
